global: This shio ramen features a clear, golden broth with tender chashu pork and menma bamboo shoots. Finely chopped green onions crown the noodles in a white bowl, set against a warm wooden table under soft, natural light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic ramen bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
regions.soup: The shio (salt) broth is clear, golden-yellow, with thin noodles and green onions floating, showing slight surface tension.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows pinkish-brown meat with marbling, glossy surface, and irregular shape with visible fat layers.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a fibrous texture and visible green specks on their surface.
